title: Supersession
description: An append that rejects/replaces a prior commitment WITHOUT deleting it. Rejection references the prior id and states the ground. Absence of a supersession record for a behavioral change = drift.

supersedes.description: The prior primary/commitment id being superseded. MUST exist. The prior record is NOT deleted.

ground.description: The stated reason for the change. Empty ground is invalid — that would make this indistinguishable from drift.

contestable.description: A supersession can itself be superseded. Nothing here is final.
